Independent reconstruction enumerated (12,42,44,9) faces, 107 nonempty faces, 252 Hasse covers, and a 51-pair acyclic pivot matching leaving one vertex and four 2-cells. By Forman this is an integral wedge of four 2-spheres. Direct independent signed fixed-face Lefschetz calculation over all 48 automorphisms yielded translation traces (4,-2,-2,0,-2,0,0,2) and the wedge-squared signed-coordinate plus translation-parity character. The empty-face -1 contribution is included; rational quotient invariants vanish. This verifies fixed Q3, not a higher-dimensional generalization.
